elements.label: Figure A3
elements.title: MS Excel Showing Rows and Columns (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of an Excel worksheet showing rows numbered 1 to 4 and columns labeled A to F. The cell A1 is selected, indicated by a green border. Above the worksheet, the Namebox shows 'A1' and the Formula Bar is empty.
